description: This file contains the implementation of the URL handling class with functions for URL encoding, decoding, Base64 encoding/decoding, and URL parsing methods, primarily operating within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A class that provides URL parsing, encoding, and decoding functionalities, including handling schemes, hostnames, ports, paths, queries, and fragments.

methods.name: URL::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a source string into a URL-encoded format, handling special characters.

methods.name: URL::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string back into its original form.

methods.name: URL::Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string, optionally adding padding.

methods.name: URL::Base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string into binary data.

methods.name: URL::Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its constituent parts such as scheme, host, port, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full URL as a string from its parsed components.

uint16_t Encode(const TCHAR * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,TCHAR * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength)
uint32_t FindNext(const TextFragment & url,const uint32_t start,const uint32_t end)
